rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the legal-scientific sense, as in 法證分析 or 法證證據.

example.english: This forensic evidence is enough to convince the court.
example.traditional: 呢啲法證證據足以令法庭信服。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 faat3 zing3 zing3 geoi3 zuk1 ji5 ling6 faat3 ting4 seon3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this only for the medical or pathology-related slice, such as a forensic pathologist, not for forensic work generally.

example.english: The forensic pathologist said after examining the body that the victim died of a heart attack.
example.traditional: 法醫驗屍後，話死者係心臟病發。
example.jyutping: faat3 ji1 jim6 si1 hau6 waa6 sei2 ze2 hai6 sam1 zong6 beng6 faat3

rows.note: Use this for the metaphorical sense of being precise and meticulous rather than for a legal investigation.

example.english: Your review of the contract was forensic—you did not miss even the tiniest wording.
example.traditional: 你睇份合約睇得好仔細，連細微字眼都唔放過。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 fan6 hap6 joek3 tai2 dak1 hou2 zi2 sai3 lin4 sai3 mei4 zi6 ngaan5 dou1 m4 fong3 gwo3
